subject: prd/plan-viewer
statement: When rendering a plan, the viewer shall render the coverage matrix with each requirement's task references linking to the corresponding task cards, and shall render deferred rows distinctly.
rationale: coverage is the completion criterion; the reviewer verifies it by following links, not by cross-referencing IDs by hand
fit_criterion: fixture: every coverage row renders, every task reference resolves to an in-page card anchor, deferred rows are visually distinct
